verdict.rationale: Mercury's official agent-skills repo lists a first-party `mercury-detect-anomaly` skill that drives the Mercury CLI. That is the product's own AI-oriented anomaly-detection capability, but the only evidence is the skill's name. Approval policies and gated disbursements route payments to manual review but are not AI flagging, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: any description of what the anomaly skill detects or how; automatic, continuous flagging rather than an agent-invoked skill; detection of out-of-policy transactions; integration with a review queue; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review

citations.quote: Agent skills that drive the Mercury CLI. Each skill is a self-contained SKILL.md following the Agent Skills format
